name: Dedericus III
source_profile:
[p. 7] Royal commissioners attempt to enforce Dedericus III's bloodline decree. Baron Merrick Rooke is killed in the ensuing violence. Northern resistance escalates into secession and civil war. 2. 3E-984–987 — The height of the civil war

[p. 7] Dedericus III dies, leaving the throne to Dedericus IV, the Falcon of Cade. The young king brings the war to an end within months. 5. 3E-991 — The Edict of the East
